project_type: Monorepo: Node.js/Fastify + Prisma backend, Next.js 16 frontend, Flutter mobile app
build_system: Backend: npm + tsx (ESM, type:module). Frontend: Next.js 16 (next build). Mobile: Flutter SDK ^3.12.2
test_framework: None configured — verification is TypeScript compile (npm run build) and flutter analyze
build_command: Backend: npm run build (tsc) in /var/www/html/be-property. Frontend: npm run build in /var/www/html/fe-property. Mobile: flutter pub get && flutter analyze in /var/www/html/property-app
test_command: Backend: npm run build. Frontend: npm run build. Mobile: flutter analyze
verification_instructions: 1. cd /var/www/html/be-property && npm run build — TypeScript must compile with zero errors. 2. cd /var/www/html/fe-property && npm run build — Next.js must build with no TypeScript errors. 3. cd /var/www/html/property-app && flutter pub get && flutter analyze — zero analysis errors.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Backend: prisma generate produces @prisma/client (run `npx prisma generate` if schema changes). No schema changes needed for this task.
environment_constraints: WhatsApp env vars (WHATSAPP_TOKEN, PHONE_NUMBER_ID, WABA_ID, VERIFY_TOKEN, APP_SECRET) are optional in development — enqueueWhatsApp short-circuits gracefully if queue is unavailable. ADMIN_PHONE is in .env.example already. Do NOT restart the dev server.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md: This Next.js version may differ from training data — read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ for API patterns. No new libraries except image_picker and file_picker for Flutter (both standard packages).
key_patterns: Backend routes: async Fastify handlers, app.authenticate preHandler, zod .safeParse for validation, prisma ORM, enqueueWhatsApp from src/whatsapp/service.ts for all WhatsApp sends. Frontend: 'use client' components, api helpers from lib/api/client.ts (api.get/post/patch), FormData for multipart, useAuth() hook. Flutter: ApiClient.get/post/patch/delete static methods, ApiClient.uploadImages for multipart, PropertyService/LeadService static classes, StatefulWidget + setState pattern.
directory_structure: be-property/src/routes/ — all Fastify route files; be-property/src/whatsapp/ — client, queue, service, templates, types, webhook, worker; fe-property/app/ — Next.js App Router pages; fe-property/components/ — shared UI components including seller-dashboard.tsx; fe-property/lib/api/client.ts — single typed API client; property-app/lib/screens/seller/ — Flutter seller screens; property-app/lib/services/ — ApiClient + service classes; property-app/lib/models/ — Dart model classes
